summary: The weekly session of the same third-party 'Scriptless Selling' mastermind run by Josh Lyons, recorded earlier the same day as the other Impromptu Zoom Meeting in this folder. Not a Primal Instinct call and no Primal prospect is present. Roughly twenty closers from unrelated offers give wins, then Josh delivers a whiteboard training on a 'triangle of influence' (doing, having, being) and a four-level progression through the mastermind: philosophy, biology, strategy, tactics. The back half is a live call review of Joao Sousa's recorded discovery call with a UK fashion e-commerce brand, covering how to extract exact monthly revenue and margins, and how to confront a prospect who was doing admin during the call. Ben Byrne contributes a wins update and two short answers.
notable: TENURE — Ben Byrne states he is brand new to the Primal Instinct offer and had closed nothing the previous month: 'after not closing anything for all of last month, I was starting to get into scarcity... started on a new offer, which is a fitness offer, which I've never sold before, and I'm actually kind of get my [expletive] kicked, which is nice, because I feel like I'm almost a beginner again.' This dates his experience on the offer to the first days of June 2026 and is essential context for every adherence score in this batch.

Ben attributes his recent income to manifestation practice rather than process: 'I was doing a lot of, like, the Neville Goddard, Law of Assumption stuff, and it started working like crazy, I got two clients, made 22k, without being on an offer from two clients.'
Ben reports 'I just did a 72 hour fast', consistent with the fasting he later described to a prospect on the Tim Wigg call the same day.

Josh teaches that follow-up is unnecessary because a sufficiently deep call implants itself permanently: 'When you've had the conversation with your prospect that they needed to have, even if they can't buy right now... They're never going to forget that conversation. It's in their skull forever.'

Josh teaches confronting an inattentive prospect by attacking the contradiction rather than rescheduling: 'is it a problem, your business and the lack of results you're getting?... between the two of you, I'm not surprised that your brand isn't where you want it to be.' He characterises the prospect internally as 'what's wrong with you, like are you mentally broken, or are you just like slow'.

The reviewed call includes the trainer instructing closers to probe whether two joint decision-makers are romantically involved because 'I have a lot more tactics and different tactics' for couples than for business partners.

The recording captures another company's confidential financials to the penny — monthly revenue of £197,903.45, £192,754.14 and £190,883.61, ad spend of £40,000-£50,000 a month, a £4,000 agency retainer, £10,000 staffing, roughly 42% gross margin and about £11,000 net a month — and names the brand. It is stored in Primal Instinct's Drive folder.

Corpus hazard: this file carries the generic title 'Impromptu Zoom Meeting' and is the second same-day file with that exact title in the Ben Byrne folder. Both are external trainings and both embed long stretches of someone else's replayed sales call, so either could be misread as a Primal Instinct sales conversation.
